articles.title: XRP Ledger developers propose creating wallets with zero XRP for stablecoin payments
articles.snippet: An experimental change would let companies cover the reserve for customer and AI-agent accounts, allowing users to start with stablecoins without first acquiring XRP.

articles.title: Nearly 90% of large businesses are embracing tokenized cash to speed up payments: DBS
articles.snippet: Stablecoins lead instruments in use or planned at 63%, ahead of tokenized deposits at 53% and tokenized money market funds at 52%.

articles.title: USDC overtakes USDT in euro stablecoin trading as EU rules reshape market: Kaiko
articles.snippet: USDC’s share of euro stablecoin trading has climbed to 56% since January 2024, with deeper liquidity as exchanges restrict USDT under MiCA.

articles.title: Moody's Rates Ripple's $2.6B RLUSD Stablecoin A2, a Day After OCC Bank Approval
articles.snippet: The ratings agency cited RLUSD's Treasury-heavy reserves, but noted that holders have no direct ownership interest in them for now.

articles.title: Robinhood Taps Ripple's Stablecoin, Treasury Software and Trading Loans
articles.snippet: Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin is live on Robinhood Chain and Bitstamp, and heads to the Robinhood app later this year as the companies deepen ties in treasury and institutional trading.
